templates.subject: Quick observation on {{company}}'s socials
templates.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Saw what you're building at {{company}} in the {{niche}} space and wanted to reach out.

Noticed a couple of untapped angles with short-form video on Reels and TikTok that could drive a ton of qualified customer acquisition for you.

We put together a quick 2-minute breakdown with 3 content concepts mapped out specifically for {{company}}.

Mind if I send it over?

Best,
{{sender_name}}

templates.subject: idea for {{company}}'s ad creative
templates.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Came across {{company}} while researching top brands in {{niche}}.

We noticed competitors in {{niche}} are running high-volume UGC and short-form video ads on Meta and TikTok to acquire customers at a much lower CAC.

We drafted 2 ad creative concepts tailored to {{company}} that could easily bump conversion rates.

Open to taking a look? Happy to send them right over.

Best,
{{sender_name}}

templates.name: local_business_smma
templates.subject: More clients for {{company}}
templates.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Love what you're doing with {{company}}.

Most businesses in {{niche}} rely purely on word of mouth, but we've been helping similar companies add 15-30 new client inquiries each month using hyper-targeted local social media campaigns and short-form video.

Would you be open to seeing a quick breakdown of how the system works?

Best,
{{sender_name}}

emails_sent.subject: Re: Ping test
emails_sent.body:
Hey Ping,

Thanks for reaching out!

Rajdeep here from Flinza Works. We help businesses like yours turn their social media into predictable customer acquisition engines, especially with short-form video and smart ad strategies. We focus on driving real results without taking up a ton of your team's time.

I'd be happy to quickly map out 2-3 specific content ideas or ad concepts tailored for Ping based on what's working right now. Would you be open to me sending that over in a quick 2-minute video?

Best,
Rajdeep / Flinza Works

replies.subject: Re: [SPAM] Partnership idea for AT Agency
replies.body:
Hi Rajdeep,

Thanks for reaching out. I took some time to review FanPull, and while the concept sounds interesting, I have a few questions and concerns from an agency perspective.

First, your website appears to be built and marketed almost entirely for individual creators rather than agencies. More importantly, it repeatedly positions FanPull as an alternative to agencies by emphasizing agency commissions and suggesting creators should keep 100% of their earnings instead.

That creates a clear contradiction if you are also looking to partner with agencies. As an agency, it would be difficult for us to work with or recommend a platform that publicly presents agencies as the problem rather than as potential partners.

Are you planning to offer a separate agency-focused solution, dashboard, pricing structure, or positioning that supports agencies instead of competing with them?

I would also like to better understand how the platform actually works, particularly regarding account security.

Your website says FanPull can publish directly to Instagram, TikTok, Reddit, X, and other platforms. However, your Terms of Service state that FanPull does not access or post on users’ accounts and that posts must be published manually from the creator’s own device.

Could you clarify:

Are Instagram, TikTok, and other accounts connected to FanPull in any way?
Does FanPull publish automatically, or does it only prepare content for manual posting?
If publishing is automated, what exact connection method do you use: official APIs, OAuth authorizations, or something else?
How do you prevent account restrictions, shadowbans, or suspensions, especially on Instagram and TikTok, where creator accounts can be flagged very quickly?
How do you handle multiple accounts per creator, newer accounts, posting limits, and accounts with previous restrictions?
How do you track actual OnlyFans subscriptions generated by each post if you do not access the creator’s OnlyFans account?
Do you offer agency-specific features such as multi-creator management, team access, separate workspaces, bulk approvals, and agency pricing?

The idea could potentially be relevant to our team, but we would need more clarity on these points before considering a partnership.

Best,

Tom
AT Agency

> Le 21 août 2026 à 18:09, Outreach <outreach@magicfitpartners.com> a écrit :
> 
> Hi there,
> 
> I came across AT Agency while looking at teams that manage OnlyFans creators. Agencies managing multiple creators tend to spend a disproportionate amount of time on promotion.
> 
> We are building FanPull, a beta tool that automates Reddit, TikTok, Instagram, X, RedGifs, and Bluesky promotion for OnlyFans creators. AI picks content, writes captions, generates variants. Creators approve in five minutes. You can see it here: https://fanpull.io
> 
> We are looking for a small group of agencies to collaborate with as we build toward launch.
> 
> Would this be relevant to your team, or is there someone else who handles creator tools and partnerships?
> 
> Best,
> Rajdeep
> F12X Studio (on behalf of FanPull)

Thank you for the detailed breakdown and for sharing the framework of your campaign.

I want to be upfront on our end as well: we strictly do not accept commission-based (CPS) or view-based performance bonus (CPM) models. Our agency operates entirely on a flat-fee basis to ensure that the creator’s baseline production labor, content ownership, and distribution value are fairly compensated from the start.

A flat fee of $250 USD is unfortunately far too low and does not cover the heavy operational and filming costs required to deliver high-quality deliverables.

If you would like to proceed with the requested scope of 1x Instagram Reel + 1x Story set, our absolute best flat rate for this package is $1,600 USD (flat fee only, no commission/bonus models applied).

We are looking for straightforward flat-fee collaborations that adequately respect the creator's time and production overhead. If this aligns with what your team can support, please let us know and we would be happy to review the agreement. Otherwise, we completely understand and appreciate your time.

Best regards,

Jennifer

Influencer Business Manager | iFLYTalent

- $300 flat fee for 1 Reel + 1 Story (we provide script, hooks, and creative direction — you film in your voice)

On the commission side, even a conservative scenario where 1% of your 370,565 following converts (~3,705 users) works out to roughly $129,675/month, sustained for 12 months if those users stay active. That's an illustrative ceiling based on your follower count, not a guarantee — actual conversion depends on the content and your audience's response.

replies.subject: Welcome to Gemini
replies.body:
Meet Gemini, your new AI assistant

With Gemini on your Android device, you can get help writing, learning,  
creating, and getting more done—even complex tasks. Go hands-free and have  
a natural, free-flowing voice conversation with Gemini Live1 to brainstorm  
ideas or talk things out. Learn  
more<<https://c.gle/AOPyDKSjz5qovamXDStPLLBof5kLL8NDdYGfwag2xUdQYOk8RkRxO-06bdiVsuPX9J7nrIRUp73qIFigAD4OpI9ngRhb2aq_adj-wuTVa1mncYckZXui0Kfd3KBaDPWwIZOOFkDYrZd__cwBF2ry8VX0_XV3spMl4dBAH3qeA-ars7E>>  
about what you can do with Gemini. If you are an Android Go user, Google  
Assistant on Android Go is in the process of being deprecated.  You will  
not be able to switch back to Google Assistant on your Go device once you  
are upgraded to Gemini on Go.

How Gemini handles data and works with other services

Gemini uses info from your device to help you

Gemini uses this info to provide more customized and context-aware help.  
For example, Gemini accesses certain system permissions and data, like call  
and message logs, and your contacts (to help you keep in touch by sending  
messages or calling). Gemini can also read information including screen  
content, page context, links,  off-screen context (to help you act on it),  
and apps on your device.

Gemini works with other services

Gemini can respond with real-time info from other services, like Google  
Maps and Flights. You can also choose to connect services like Google  
Workspace and YouTube Music. If Gemini finds a connected app that can help,  
it will send information from your conversation and other relevant  
information to that connected app to help it generate a better response.  
You can manage your app settings.2 Learn  
more<<https://c.gle/AOPyDKR_jvDuPtc-vA93MfrceWd1Zsqz-AtA7RWqW5fBajMSl4pyEGfeI3Jrg_2Qg-tFZ8YBch1EVOhAjE7ktZHsbiymePWzy-GCvHoEEdXe4NKSUPVe_eROXJMmdfG72zkaxFZ4rWRECmiRR_o9ISLbuxIOxcfO_kWjcZhGuaDwe1ox8N1B7zRha4yE>>.

Things to know when speaking to Gemini

If “Hey Google” & Voice  
Match<<https://c.gle/AOPyDKSLhBjPxHTyoAdnWeV2Kuw-mMLQy-xnsLzDY1wfF9Ek_tfV3KDzRjbHGBz2FfH5cYonGgAmRa8RIg_nXb_jQEfeK2QbmuRLQ-Iz0t2YXCXYbZeT4A21AH41A3bpPs18tR9T4MXn7ghDLLcwwaBAnKWUotJrp-dASbBAQLbx1uIoITkrL-5sDDkZ8A>>  
are on in Settings, you can talk to Gemini hands-free. Gemini may activate  
when you didn’t intend it to, for example, if it detects a noise like “Hey  
Google,” or if you accidentally activate it by touch. If Gemini responds,  
it will treat your input like a normal activation. “Hey Google” is not  
available for Android Go users.

Gemini responses on lock screen

Gemini helps you with answers and actions even when your device is locked.  
Gemini will still require you to unlock for some actions, for example, when  
responses contain your personal content from apps (such as calendar  
events). You can change your Gemini on lock screen settings. Learn  
more<<https://c.gle/AOPyDKS5UQDEMtadp-IeuOuv762OvwOVvWRzuCR3E7skAdtXZz4259LmTT0lR60wHw-kDaLvqkgWIXLYNXNw8eLFN5fGmVMjI7mJcjdUypLYMZajeDTlIc86oYNh-ysQi__QFsNiQ2_F4BDJ_ert45MfISDC96n4hVguo6JAH7SF3vS_Xifj>>.
